```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true

async function makeSolrRequest(q, fl="id,formatId,resourceMap", rows=100, debugQuery=false) {
    const solrUrl = "https://arcticdata.io/metacat/d1/mn/v2/query/solr/";
    const url = new URL(solrUrl);
    url.searchParams.append("fl", fl);
    url.searchParams.append("rows", rows);
    url.searchParams.append("wt", "json");
    url.searchParams.append("debugQuery", debugQuery);
    url.searchParams.append("q", q);
    const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {"Accept":"application/json"}
    });
    console.log(response.url);
    return await response.json();
}

function SolrEncode(value) {
    const specials = ['+', '-', '&', '!', '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', ']', '^', '"', '~', '*', '?', ':', '\\'];
    const regexp = new RegExp("(\\" + specials.join("|\\") + ")", "g");
    let v = value.replace(regexp, "\\$1");
    if (v != value) {
        return '"' + v + '"';
    }
    return v;
}

async function getObsolescenceChain(pid) {
    const fl = "id,obsoletedBy,formatId";
    const q = `{!graph from=id to=obsoletes}id:${SolrEncode(pid)}`;
    const response = await makeSolrRequest(q, fl);
    console.log(response);
    const data = [];
    for (const doc of response.response.docs) {
        data.push({id:doc.id, obsoletedBy:doc.obsoletedBy || null});
    }
    return data
}

async function obsOrder(data) {
    const sorted_data = [];
    let chead = null;
    let counter = 200;
    while (data.length > 0) {
        for (let i=0; i<data.length; i++) {
            const o = data[i];
            const v = o.obsoletedBy || null;
            if (v === chead) {
                chead = o.id;
                sorted_data.push(o);
                data.splice(i, 1);                
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return sorted_data;
}


viewof PID = Inputs.text({label:"PID", value:"urn:uuid:a8ab11f9-3a1c-472b-850b-32b7ebcf65a8", width:"100%"})

//md`the pid = ${PID}`;

viewof obsdata = Inputs.table(await getObsolescenceChain(PID).then((data) => {return obsOrder(data)}));


function generateMM(data) {
    console.log("generateMM");

}

mmdata = generateMM(obsdata);
```
